# The shape a divided credit exports to, imported into a fresh book: one
# transaction holding the bank side, the part that settled an invoice — which
# carries no `lot_owner:`, because it belongs to an invoice's lot and the
# export derives that line from live lot state — and the credit left over,
# which does carry one.
#
# Reading the loose split's lot, nothing says whose it is. The split itself
# says it came out of a credit — `applied_from_credit`, which the import writes
# on every split it moves out of one, and which an export carries back — and
# the credit beside it says whose: both halves came out of one credit, and that
# credit is Alpha's.
customer "C-TWO-A"
	name: "Alpha"
	currency: CAD

customer "C-TWO-B"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD

2026-05-15 * "Alpha pays ahead"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -40.00 CAD
		applied_from_credit: "true"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -60.00 CAD
		lot_owner: "customer:C-TWO-A"
